lessons.observation: Creation and export were safe, but a returning user could not verify a local file.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: The no-transfer boundary worked; continuity stopped before local reinspection.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: v1.7.76 intentionally implemented the smallest useful creation slice.
lessons.product_change_made: Added strict device-only import inspection, integrity/expiry checks, central compatibility guidance, and local reset.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added a maturity rule distinguishing central local inspection from product-local portal import acceptance.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer local inspection and explicit compatibility states before proposing automatic or server-side transfer.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Test malformed, oversized, unknown-field, tampered, expired, future-dated, and destination-mismatch files while asserting zero network/persistence primitives.

lessons.observation: The durable improvement backlog was briefly collapsed during evidence editing and had to be restored.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Regression tests caught the issue, but only after the list had been altered.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: The dual-track gate checked report structure, not carry-forward completeness or evidence existence.
lessons.test_or_evidence_that_revealed_it: v1.7.76 regression run and the preserved 21-item NEXT_VERSION_IMPROVEMENT_LIST.json
lessons.product_change_made: Kept the full public/product readiness backlog visible and updated the Journey Handoff item without deleting its portal-local dependency.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added a release-evidence coverage validator requiring all prior unresolved IDs, real files/tests, prior limitation dispositions, and exact source identity.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Reject candidates that gain a new feature by losing unresolved obligations or unverifiable evidence.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Run evidence coverage before candidate freeze and again after candidate sealing.

unresolved_learning_questions: Which exact portal will first accept the local plan schema and what product-local data-minimization changes will it require?
Can a QR representation meet real-device, shoulder-surfing, and accessibility standards without encouraging automatic transfer?
next_version_learning_priorities: Obtain one exact product-local adapter acceptance before enabling any portal import.
Measure inspector comprehension only through privacy-preserving, separately authorized methods.
Evaluate candidate scoring as advisory evidence only, never as a substitute for hard constraints or owner judgment.
